stages.title: The site, before the building
stages.state: Earthmoving and trench/form preparation. No invented piles or basement.

stages.title: A concrete ground plane
stages.state: Broad A ground/base slab and early support indications; B base timing not asserted.

stages.title: B wing leads
stages.state: B solid walls/core and stacked working tiers dominate. A remains low with deck preparation.

stages.title: The transfer deck is prepared
stages.state: Broad A formed/reinforced deck with major openings; B/connection remains above it.

stages.title: The transfer pour
stages.state: A transfer slab resolves to concrete while the advanced B state holds.

stages.title: A catches up; the form emerges
stages.state: A upper slabs, supports and solid enclosure progress; remaining B structure completes. Balcony concrete belongs with its supporting floor.

stages.title: Curves, roof and rooftop shell
stages.state: Curved concrete bands, staggered roof profiles, access mass, raised terrace and pool shell. No water or final coping yet.

stages.title: Architecture becomes complete
stages.state: Glazing, final façade response, screens, balustrades, terrace finish, coping and water.

stages.title: Completed Anna Athina
stages.state: All 35 groups restored exactly to the approved visual endpoint; temporary construction states absent.

stages.title: The approved blade passage
stages.state: Exact approved completed model, path, blade and colour handling.

stages.title: Real Anna Athina, close
stages.state: Real façade-side bridge; blade clears and native video takes over.

stages.title: The completed-project reveal
stages.state: Real wider drone reveal, then ordinary project content.
